+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.syntax import Syntax
+
+def test_syntax_padding():
+    code = "print('hello')"
+    syntax = Syntax(code, "python", line_numbers=True, highlight_lines={1})
+    console = Console(width=40)
+    
+    segments = console.render(syntax)
+    
+    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):
+        print(f"Segment {i}: '{segment.text}' len={len(segment.text)}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_syntax_padding()
